t: When $(thing)ComputerCraft/$ or $(thing)Open Computers/$ is installed, you'll be able to interact with almost every $(pncr) machine, and $(l:machines/drone_interface)Drones/$.$(p)Any of the machines listed here can be interacted with as CC/OC peripherals.
当安装了$(thing)ComputerCraft/$或$(thing)Open Computers/$后，你将能够与几乎所有$(#228)气动工艺$()机器以及$(l:machines/drone_interface)无人机/$进行交互。$(p)此处列出的任何机器都可以作为 CC/OC 外设进行交互。

In Lua, you can run $(thing)m = peripheral.wrap(<side>)/$, where $(thing)<side>/$ is the side of the computer the peripheral is connected to (top, bottom, left, right, back, front). Then you can use any of the following functions with $(thing)m.<functionName>/$.$(p)Anywhere in the following functions where a '<side>' appears as one of the arguments, 'up', 'down', 'north', 'south', 'east', 'west' are valid.

在 Lua 中，你可以运行$(thing)m = peripheral.wrap(<side>)/$，其中$(thing)<side>/$表示该 peripheral 连接在计算机的哪一侧（上、下、左、右、后、前）。然后，你就可以通过$(thing)m.<functionName>/$使用以下任意函数。$(p)在下列函数中，凡是某个参数位置出现 '<side>' 的地方，都可以使用 'up'、'down'、'north'、'south'、'east'、'west'。

You will need to use an $(item)Adapter/$ to connect your computer to $(pnc) machines; they will then appear as OC components, which show up if you run $(thing)=components.list()/$ in an OC Lua environment. Then any of the following functions can be used, e.g. $(thing)p = components.air_compressor.getPressure()/$ will retrieve the current pressure of an attached $(item)Air Compressor/$.

你需要使用一个$(item)适配器/$，将你的计算机连接到$(pnc)机器；这样它们就会显示为 OC 组件，并且在 OC Lua 环境中运行$(thing)=components.list()/$时可以看到它们。随后即可使用以下任意函数，例如$(thing)p = components.air_compressor.getPressure()/$会获取已连接的$(item)空气压缩机/$的当前气压。

The following methods are common to $(italic)all/$ $(pncr) machines:$(li)$(#800)getPressure(), getPressure(<side>)/$: gets the machine's pressure. <side> is optional, only useful for the $(l:machines/vacuum_pump)Vacuum Pump/$, which has side-specific pressures.$(li)$(#800)getDangerPressure()/$: get the pressure at which the machine is at risk of explosion$(li)$(#800)getCriticalPressure()/$: get the hard maximum pressure at which the machine will certainly explode

以下方法适用于$(italic)所有/$$(#228)气动工艺$()机器：$(li)$(#800)getPressure(), getPressure(<side>)/$：获取机器的压力。<side>为可选参数，仅对$(l:machines/vacuum_pump)真空泵/$有用，因为它的压力会因侧面而异。$(li)$(#800)getDangerPressure()/$：获取机器存在爆炸风险时的压力$(li)$(#800)getCriticalPressure()/$：获取机器必定会爆炸的压力硬上限

The following methods are common to $(italic)all/$ $(pncr) machines which support the concept of $(l:base_concepts/heat)Heat/$:$(li)$(#800)getTemperature(), getTemperature(<side>)/$: gets the machine's temperature. <side> is optional, only useful for the $(l:machines/vortex_tube)Vortex Tube/$, which has different temperatures depending on the side.
以下方法是$(italic)所有/$支持$(l:base_concepts/heat)热量/$概念的$(#228)气动工艺$()机器都通用的：$(li)$(#800)getTemperature(), getTemperature(<side>)/$：获取机器的温度。<side>为可选参数，仅对$(l:machines/vortex_tube)涡流管/$有用，因为它在不同侧面的温度不同。

$(li)$(#800)setExternalControl(<true/false>)/$: When true, this will prevent the cannon being rotated with normal methods (GPS Tool insertion, change in Range Upgrades..)$(li)$(#800)setTargetLocation(<x>,<y>,<z>)/$: Point the cannon at the given target location instead of that stored in a GPS Tool.
$(li)$(#800)setExternalControl(<true/false>)/$：为 true 时，这将阻止使用常规方法旋转加农炮（插入定位工具、改变范围升级等）。$(li)$(#800)setTargetLocation(<x>,<y>,<z>)/$：将加农炮指向给定的目标位置，而不是使用存储在定位工具中的目标位置。

$(li)$(#800)setRotationAngle(<angle>)/$: Rotate the cannon yaw to the angle specified.$(li)$(#800)setHeightAngle(<angle>)/$: Rotate the cannon pitch to the angle specified.$(li)$(#800)isDoneRotating()/$: Returns true when the cannon is done turning.$(li)$(#800)getMinWorkingPressure()/$: Returns the minimal pressure needed to fire the cannon (the yellow to green threshold in the GUI).

$(li)$(#800)setRotationAngle(<angle>)/$：将火炮的偏航旋转到指定的角度。$(li)$(#800)setHeightAngle(<angle>)/$：将火炮的俯仰旋转到指定的角度。$(li)$(#800)isDoneRotating()/$：当火炮完成转动时返回 true。$(li)$(#800)getMinWorkingPressure()/$：返回发射火炮所需的最低气压（GUI 中从黄色到绿色的阈值）。
$(li)$(#800)fire()/$: Fires the cannon, provided that there's enough pressure, and when there are items inserted. Returns true if successful.
$(li)$(#800)fire()/$：发射火炮，前提是有足够的压力且已插入物品。若成功则返回 true。

$(li)$(#800)setExternalControl(<true/false>)/$: When true, set the Elevator's $(#f00)redstone mode/$ to 'Elevator Caller' mode, which is also applicable for computer control. You don't have to set it prior to calling $(#800)setTargetHeight()/$; that method will change the Elevator to external control automatically.
$(li)$(#800)setExternalControl(<true/false>)/$：当设为 true 时，会将电梯的$(#f00)红石模式/$设为“电梯呼叫器”模式，这同样适用于计算机控制。你不必在调用$(#800)setTargetHeight()/$之前先进行设置；该方法会自动将电梯切换为外部控制。

$(li)$(#800)getMinWorkingPressure()/$: Get the minimal pressure needed to extend the Elevator. Making the Elevator descend is free.$(li)$(#800)setTargetHeight(<height>)/$: Sets the Elevator's target height to the height parsed (in meters/blocks, floating point).$(li)$(#800)getTargetHeight()/$: Get the Elevator's target height (in meters/blocks, floating point).$(li)$(#800)getCurrentHeight()/$: Get the Elevator's current height (in meters/blocks, floating point).

$(li)$(#800)getMinWorkingPressure()/$：获取升降机伸展所需的最低压力。让升降机下降不需要消耗压力。$(li)$(#800)setTargetHeight(<height>)/$：将升降机的目标高度设置为解析出的高度（以米/方块为单位，浮点数）。$(li)$(#800)getTargetHeight()/$：获取升降机的目标高度（以米/方块为单位，浮点数）。$(li)$(#800)getCurrentHeight()/$：获取升降机的当前高度（以米/方块为单位，浮点数）。
$(li)$(#800)getVelocity()/$: Gets the elevator's current velocity, in blocks per tick (where there are 20 ticks in a second). Negative values indicate that the elevator is descending.
$(li)$(#800)getVelocity()/$：获取电梯当前的速度，单位为方块/刻（1 秒有 20 刻）。负值表示电梯正在下降。
$(li)$(#800)getSensorNames()/$: Returns a table of all known sensor names.$(li)$(#800)getSensor()/$: Returns the name of the currently-selected sensor.
$(li)$(#800)getSensorNames()/$：返回包含所有已知传感器名称的表。$(li)$(#800)getSensor()/$：返回当前所选传感器的名称。

$(li)$(#800)setSensor(<sensorName>), setSensor(<index>), setSensor()/$: Sets the current selected sensor. <sensorName> is one of the names returned by $(#800)getSensorNames()/$. <index> is an index on the returned table from $(#800)getSensorNames()/$. When using the no-arg $(#800)setSensor()/$, no sensor will be selected (the machine goes idle and uses no air). Returns true if the sensor is possible with the currently inserted upgrades.

$(li)$(#800)setSensor(<sensorName>)、setSensor(<index>)、setSensor()/$：设置当前选中的传感器。<sensorName> 是$(#800)getSensorNames()/$返回的名称之一。<index> 是$(#800)getSensorNames()/$返回表中的一个索引。使用无参数的$(#800)setSensor()/$时，将不会选中任何传感器（机器会进入空闲状态，且不消耗空气）。如果当前插入的升级支持该传感器，则返回 true。

$(li)$(#800)setTextField(<text>)/$: Some sensors use a text field to specify additional options (e.g. the 'Entities in range' sensor accepts an $(l:base_concepts/entity_filter)entity filter string/$). You can specify the desired text in here.$(li)$(#800)getTextField()/$: Returns the text currently stored in the $(thing)Universal Sensor/$.
$(li)$(#800)setTextField(<text>)/$：某些传感器会使用文本字段来指定额外选项（例如，“范围内的实体”传感器接受一个$(l:base_concepts/entity_filter)实体过滤字符串/$）。你可以在这里指定所需的文本。$(li)$(#800)getTextField()/$：返回当前存储在$(thing)万能传感器/$中的文本。

$(li)$(#800)isSensorEventBased()/$: There are two categories of sensors: event-based, and polling sensors. Event based sensors wait for something to happen (player attacks, item pickups). Polling sensors check the state of the sensor periodically (entities in range, world time, rain sensor). This function returns true if the current selected sensor is event-based.
$(li)$(#800)isSensorEventBased()/$：传感器分为两类：基于事件的传感器，以及轮询式传感器。基于事件的传感器会等待某些事情发生（玩家攻击、拾取物品）。轮询式传感器则会定期检查传感器的状态（范围内的实体、世界时间、雨量传感器）。此函数会在当前所选传感器为基于事件的传感器时返回 true。

$(li)$(#800)getSensorValue()/$: If the current sensor is a polling sensor, return the (non-inverted) redstone signal it would output. Note that setting the sensor and immediately getting the output is unreliable, as many polling sensors poll infrequently for performance reasons. Thus, this method causes a pull-event to be triggered; get the output in response to that. If no polling sensor is selected, an exception will be thrown.
$(li)$(#800)getSensorValue()/$：如果当前传感器是轮询传感器，则返回它将输出的（未反相）红石信号。请注意，设置传感器后立刻获取输出并不可靠，因为出于性能原因，许多轮询传感器的轮询频率较低。因此，此方法会触发一个 pull-event；请在响应该事件时获取输出。如果未选中轮询传感器，则会抛出异常。

$(li)$(#800)getMinWorkingPressure()/$: Returns the minimal pressure needed to make the Universal Sensor work (the yellow to green threshold in the GUI).$(li)$(#800)setGPSToolCoordinate(<slotIndex>,<x>,<y>,<z>)/$: Sets the location stored in the GPS Tool located in the given slot (starting with 1) to the provided location. This is useful for sensors that use a location.
$(li)$(#800)getMinWorkingPressure()/$：返回使万能传感器工作的最低气压（GUI 中黄色到绿色的阈值）。$(li)$(#800)setGPSToolCoordinate(<slotIndex>,<x>,<y>,<z>)/$：将给定槽位中（从 1 开始）的定位工具所存储的位置设置为指定位置。这对使用位置的传感器很有用。

For event based sensors (e.g. the player right click sensor), getting the sensor value is event-based. You get the event by doing a $(#800)<arguments> = os.pullEvent("universalSensor")/$. Usually the arguments consist of <eventName, redstoneStrength>. The player right click sensor is an exception, as <eventName, redstoneStrength, interactedX, interactedY, interactedZ> is returned. This allows for some interesting uses...
对于基于事件的传感器（例如玩家右键点击传感器），获取传感器值是以事件驱动的方式进行的。你可以通过执行$(#800)<arguments> = os.pullEvent("universalSensor")/$来获取该事件。通常，返回的参数为 <事件名称, 红石信号强度>。玩家右键点击传感器是个例外，它会返回 <事件名称, 红石信号强度, 交互X, 交互Y, 交互Z>。这就带来了一些有趣的用法……
